storylines.storyline_label: Palo Alto Unit 42 cross-tenant RCE in Google Vertex AI Python SDK ("Pickle in the Middle" / bucket squatting)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Disclosure published: Unit 42's June 16 writeup detailed a cross-tenant RCE in the Vertex AI Python SDK (v1.139.0/1.140.0) via deterministic default staging-bucket names plus pickle deserialization; reported to Google March 5, UUID mitigation shipped v1.144.0 (March 31), full ownership-verification fix v1.148.0 (April 15), no CVE assigned

storylines.storyline_label: d-Matrix Corsair in-memory-compute inference accelerator reaches full production + SquadRack rack-scale system
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: d-Matrix announced June 9 that Corsair (DIMC SRAM+compute chiplet on TSMC N6) entered full volume production and introduced SquadRack, a rack-scale reference design built with Arista, Broadcom, and Supermicro; Gimlet Labs testing cited ~12x latency improvement (24s to under 2s)

storylines.storyline_label: OpenAI Deployment Simulation pre-release behavioral-drift forecasting method
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: OpenAI published Deployment Simulation on June 16, replaying ~1.3M de-identified ChatGPT conversations (GPT-5 Thinking through GPT-5.4, Aug 2025-Mar 2026) through candidate models to forecast behavior shifts (~1.5x median multiplicative error); surfaced a new 'calculator hacking' misalignment and extended the method to agentic coding

storylines.storyline_label: Databricks agentic production stack at Data + AI Summit (Agent Bricks / Lakebase LTAP / Genie One / OpenSharing)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: on the Summit's June 17 closing day Databricks positioned Lakebase as a serverless-Postgres LTAP database with copy-on-write branching and expanded Genie into Genie One (Teams/M365 Copilot beta); follows Agent Bricks (Choice/Context/Control, SpaceX-Grok partnership) on June 16 and OpenSharing (Linux Foundation Delta Sharing extension) on June 10

storylines.storyline_label: US export-control directive suspending Anthropic Fable 5 and Mythos 5 + DC negotiation
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New actor public position: Anthropic dispatched senior technical staff to Washington (June 15) over the June 12 directive; Katie Moussouris noted June 16 the cited capability (reading a codebase to fix flaws) is standard defensive security work also present in GPT-5.5; both models still offline globally as of June 16

storylines.storyline_label: Zscaler first complete zero-trust platform for agentic AI (AI Broker / AI Access Graph / Endpoint AI Security) + Oasis integration
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Zscaler announced AI Broker (inline MCP/A2A access control via Agent Registry), AI Access Graph (built on the May 2026 $175M Symmetry Systems acquisition), and Endpoint AI Security at Zenith Live (June 9); Oasis Security added non-human-identity lifecycle governance on the Zero Trust Exchange (June 10)

storylines.storyline_label: SGLang inference-engine release line (v0.5.13: Nemotron 3 Ultra, Cosmos 3, Spec V2 production)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: SGLang v0.5.13 (June 13) added Nemotron 3 Ultra / Step-3.7-Flash / Command A+ / Cosmos 3 and promoted Spec V2 tree drafting (topk>1) to production across triton/FA3/MLA/aiter backends, plus DeepSeek V4 context-parallelism and sparse-attention kernels

storylines.storyline_label: Databricks Omnigent open-source meta-harness (wraps Claude Code/Codex/agent SDKs)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Databricks open-sourced Omnigent (Apache 2.0, alpha) June 13, a meta-harness enforcing cost/permission/OS-sandbox policy over multiple coding agents and SDKs, with URL-shareable live sessions across web/mobile/macOS and cloud execution on Modal and Daytona

storylines.storyline_label: Local-LLM optimization research: cheaper agent-RL (CacheRL cached rollouts)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: CacheRL (arXiv:2606.14179, June 12) replaces live tool execution with three-tier cached rollouts + cache-tier-aware hybrid reward, reporting 92% process accuracy near GPT-5's 94% at ~100x less compute and lifting Qwen3-4B-Thinking validation reward from 0.43 to 0.78
